name: Monterrey
living: the beacon tower's green laser shimmers and pulses softly (the beam is NOT in the glow mask: key it by colour, G - max(R, B) > 40, above the skyline; it runs from the tower tip at concept (837, 478) out through the right edge of the concept at (1024, 232) and on to the plate's right edge)
the saddle mountain's peaks lose their last warm rim light as the dusk deepens
the low sun flares softly behind the left light tower
city tower windows flicker on one by one
the purple-orange pixel clouds drift slowly (sky layer drift)
the light-tower lamp banks breathe gently, moths drifting through their cones
a small flock of birds crosses the sunset now and then
the red cactus flowers beyond the wall sway in the breeze
crowd shimmer in the stands, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
